name: Nisaazda

abilities.name: Blood Swirl
abilities.description: Nisaazda waves her hands together as she channels a spell, creating a massive pool of swirling blood in the center of the arena, causing high continuous damage if standing within.

abilities.name: Crimson Cloud
abilities.description: Nisaazda disappears into a cloud of swirling blood mist and moves away from you in the arena, indicated by a circular AoE, dealing high damage if you make contact with the mist.

abilities.name: Corpuscle Cannonade
abilities.description: Nisaazda holds up her staff to the air and unleashes a barrage of blood projectiles at you. This can be interrupted.

abilities.name: Impregnable Corpulence
abilities.description: Nisaazda summons a group of Hemonculi to assist. They initially have a damage immunity shield, which can only be removed by destroying a Hemo Helot near them.

abilities.name: Summon Sangiin's Thirst
abilities.description: When Nisaazda is away from you, she will start performing a spell to summon the blood gargoyle, Sangiin's Thirst. You must fling a Hemo Helot at her to stop her from doing so. Nisaazda summoning her blood creatures

dialogue.speaker: Chevalier Renald
dialogue.line: This is insanity, Grundwulf! Can't you see that these Hollowfangs spout nothing but hollow promises?
dialogue.trigger: When you first enter Moongrave Fane, you may overhear Nisaazda giving Chevalier Renald an ultimatum, before she heads further into the ruins

dialogue.speaker: Grundwulf
dialogue.line: Dragons are here, Renald! The world will end in fire before your fabled Emperor comes! If you won't act, I will!
dialogue.trigger: When you first enter Moongrave Fane, you may overhear Nisaazda giving Chevalier Renald an ultimatum, before she heads further into the ruins

dialogue.speaker: Nisaazda
dialogue.line: The Devourer has chosen, old bat! Do not trouble us again!
dialogue.trigger: When you first enter Moongrave Fane, you may overhear Nisaazda giving Chevalier Renald an ultimatum, before she heads further into the ruins

dialogue.speaker: Nisaazda
dialogue.line: Renald is slippery, but Nisaazda will catch him in time. You will not be so lucky.
dialogue.trigger: The following dialogue is in chronological order but is unsorted. It occurs throughout the dungeon

dialogue.speaker: Hollowfang Beastmaster
dialogue.line: There are many holes through which a rat can scurry here. Keep on guard.
dialogue.trigger: The following dialogue is in chronological order but is unsorted. It occurs throughout the dungeon

dialogue.speaker: Chevalier Renald
dialogue.line: I've had enough wading through you leeches.
dialogue.trigger: The following dialogue is in chronological order but is unsorted. It occurs throughout the dungeon

dialogue.speaker: Hollowfang Assassin
dialogue.line: Nisaazda, they are coming!
dialogue.trigger: The following dialogue is in chronological order but is unsorted. It occurs throughout the dungeon

dialogue.speaker: Chevalier Renald
dialogue.line: The Dragon lies beneath that temple. I can smell its blood on the air. Push through!
dialogue.trigger: The following dialogue is in chronological order but is unsorted. It occurs throughout the dungeon

dialogue.speaker: Nisaazda
dialogue.line: That's far enough, old bat!
dialogue.trigger: The following dialogue is in chronological order but is unsorted. It occurs throughout the dungeon

dialogue.speaker: Chevalier Renald
dialogue.line: Out of my way, leech. I have more pressing concerns than ending your life.
dialogue.trigger: The following dialogue is in chronological order but is unsorted. It occurs throughout the dungeon

dialogue.speaker: Chevalier Renald
dialogue.line: Surrender, Nisaazda, or are you going to fight us all?.
dialogue.trigger: The following dialogue is in chronological order but is unsorted. It occurs throughout the dungeon

dialogue.speaker: Nisaazda
dialogue.line: This one won't have to.
dialogue.trigger: The following dialogue is in chronological order but is unsorted. It occurs throughout the dungeon

dialogue.speaker: Nisaazda
dialogue.line: You've already lost your friend, next your life!
dialogue.trigger: The following dialogue is in chronological order but is unsorted. It occurs throughout the dungeon

dialogue.speaker: Chevalier Renald
dialogue.line: I've skinned many a dragon. A cat will not be trouble.
dialogue.trigger: The following dialogue is in chronological order but is unsorted. It occurs throughout the dungeon

dialogue.speaker: Chevalier Renald
dialogue.line: Cats aren't the only ones who toy with their prey.
dialogue.trigger: The following dialogue is in chronological order but is unsorted. It occurs throughout the dungeon

dialogue.speaker: Nisaazda
dialogue.line: This one has no fear of your sword, old bat. She is too swift.
dialogue.trigger: The following dialogue is in chronological order but is unsorted. It occurs throughout the dungeon

dialogue.speaker: Nisaazda
dialogue.line: Nisaazda will feed you to her weakest warriors!
dialogue.trigger: The following dialogue is in chronological order but is unsorted. It occurs throughout the dungeon

dialogue.speaker: Chevalier Renald
dialogue.line: Such a menacing kitten.
dialogue.trigger: The following dialogue is in chronological order but is unsorted. It occurs throughout the dungeon

dialogue.speaker: Chevalier Renald
dialogue.line: You were always the stronger swordsman, Grundwulf, but not the better one.
dialogue.trigger: When Renald confronts Grundwulf, Nisaazda will attack the chevalier while he is distracted

dialogue.speaker: Grundwulf
dialogue.line: Damn you, Renald! We can end it all! The empire can be reborn! Right here!
dialogue.trigger: When Renald confronts Grundwulf, Nisaazda will attack the chevalier while he is distracted

dialogue.speaker: Chevalier Renald
dialogue.line: Whatever you become through this madness, it will not be Emperor.
dialogue.trigger: When Renald confronts Grundwulf, Nisaazda will attack the chevalier while he is distracted

dialogue.speaker: Grundwulf
dialogue.line: Then do it, Renald! I'd rather to die with blade in hand, than go back to that honorless life of yours!
dialogue.trigger: When Renald confronts Grundwulf, Nisaazda will attack the chevalier while he is distracted

dialogue.line: <Nisaazda then appears and attacks Chevalier Renald.>
dialogue.trigger: When Renald confronts Grundwulf, Nisaazda will attack the chevalier while he is distracted

dialogue.speaker: Nisaazda
dialogue.line: You hesitated, old bat.
dialogue.trigger: When Renald confronts Grundwulf, Nisaazda will attack the chevalier while he is distracted

dialogue.speaker: Grundwulf
dialogue.line: I didn't need help.
dialogue.trigger: When Renald confronts Grundwulf, Nisaazda will attack the chevalier while he is distracted

dialogue.speaker: Nisaazda
dialogue.line: We have no more time for this. His allies are here.
dialogue.trigger: When Renald confronts Grundwulf, Nisaazda will attack the chevalier while he is distracted

dialogue.speaker: Nisaazda
dialogue.line: Nisaazda will exact a debt of blood owed for her clan!
dialogue.trigger: When Renald confronts Grundwulf, Nisaazda will attack the chevalier while he is distracted

dialogue.speaker: Grundwulf
dialogue.line: You're owed that much.
dialogue.trigger: When Renald confronts Grundwulf, Nisaazda will attack the chevalier while he is distracted

related_quests: The Sanguine Successor: Prevent a clan of vampires from draining the blood of a captured dragon.
Pledge: Moongrave Fane: Prove you are truly Undaunted by conquering Moongrave Fane.
summary: Nisaazda is the Khajiit Clan Mother of the vampiric Hollowfang Clan, who have come to Moongrave Fane to take the power within for themselves. She has manipulated Grundwulf of the Dragonguard, playing on his desires for a true Dragonborn to take the throne of Cyrodiil and sort out the mess that Tamriel is in.
